title: AsciiArtDef
description:
An ascii_art definition from JSON type `"ascii_art"`.

Defines an ASCII art picture that can be referenced by items and other game objects. The picture is an array of strings, each representing a line of ASCII art.

copy_from.description: Base definition id to copy fields from.

picture.description: The ASCII art picture, as an array of strings (each string is a line).
